subject: Material selection for reliable manufacture
hook: Cutting-list delays usually start with the board spec.
ig:
Cutting-list delays usually start with the board spec, not the sizes.

For joiners, fitters and kitchen companies sending work out for cutting and edging, here's what to confirm before the list leaves your desk:

1. Sheet size — 2440 × 1220 or 2800 × 2070 changes the nesting and board count
2. Exact decor code and supplier — names alone aren't enough to match panels and edging
3. Grain direction on woodgrain decors — mark it per part
4. Board thickness — drilling and grooves depend on it
5. Edging per edge — which edges, which ABS thickness (0.4, 1 or 2 mm)

Get those five right and the job goes straight onto the saw instead of back to you with questions.

We cut, edge, drill and assemble for the trade from our workshop in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent. Save this checklist, and find our trade services via the link in bio.
